notes.title: Ask Chloe #1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536519/73df67e060738f380942f2d3cf8a662a590b545e.png[/img]
Hi! We begin a new show "Ask Chloe".
[previewyoutube=Qry79tMaeWs;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
Once every two weeks we will publish one video, one answer to one question. Our paid members on Patreon can leave their questions in comments under corresponding post: [url=https://www.patreon.com/FreeFallLab]Free Fall Lab on Patreon[/url]

notes.title: "Ask Chloe" show announcement!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536519/16d105f60bb61fb440d809b2b1390f8a0051b8d4.jpg[/img]
Hi! We decided to bring more fun and dynamic stuff into the development process. Waiting for the [b]Heart of Pacific[/b] shouldn't be boring. So just in a few days, maybe a week, Chloe will announce her new show for our [url=https://www.patreon.com/c/FreeFallLab]Patreon[/url] followers!) Thanks again for being here with us! Keep in touch!)

notes.title: DEMO - Soon
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536519/da673b31e9d9ccd3fdb062845fafc0e723c0b5e8.png[/img]
Hi! We are going to publish a free demo in May. It will contain about 3% of the story and 10% of the first hot animated scene. Thank you so much for following us!)

notes.title: Trailer!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536519/cbe87bf19036aff9817d22189b37fda9509d97eb.png[/img]
We are pleased to announce that we have published the trailer on the store page. The process of creating it took much less time than we initially estimated. Visit the product page here on Steam to check it! We hope that you will like it and that you will also be looking forward to the release of the game.

notes.title: Working on Trailer - How do you like the Soundtrack?
notes.content:
Things are going even faster than we expected. Probably we can expect the trailer to be published here on Steam in the first half of April. This is how it will sound like:
[previewyoutube=QNrIMAJmCYw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Best experience on Steam Deck
notes.content:
Steam Deck is our priority gaming device. So we test the [b]Heart of Pacific[/b] using it all the time. All inputs, menus and subtitle text size - all will work the best way
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536519/fd22b1fb3dcccdefa91f4fa74c89b79605d270d4.png[/img]

notes.title: Real Open World Island
notes.content:
We've created this artificial island plateau really huge with so many locations. Each scene of this story will happen in a different place. Can't wait to show you all that!) So let's just wait. We are going to finish it till October the 2nd
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536519/f3d08080d2e1d83736573e91c612b8bc60fe0c03.png[/img]

notes.title: Trailer coming soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536519/3b75120f41996c3bd2d25a47bfb1b2ef58ba4173.png[/img]
Hi everyone!)
We are going to add the main trailer of the [b]Heart of Pacific[/b] here on May. It will include everything you expect to see: many novel images, some pieces of animated cut scenes and, of course, animated sex scenes. We just need to create much more animations to have enough content for trailer.
Thank you for following! Stay in touch!)
